name: Andalusia
summary: Green, white and green horizontal bands with the Andalusian arms: Hercules between two pillars, holding two lions, with the motto 'Dominator Hercules Fundator'.
origin: The green-white-green flag was adopted by the Andalusian nationalist assembly of Ronda in 1918, promoted by Blas Infante. It became official in the 1981 Statute of Autonomy.

colors.name: Green
colors.meaning: Hope and union; also linked to the Umayyad green.

symbols.name: Hercules and the pillars
symbols.description: Hercules between the Pillars of Hercules, holding two lions.

facts: Blas Infante is honoured as the 'Father of the Andalusian Nation'.
Andalusia is Spain's most populous autonomous community.
clues: Green, white and green bands with Hercules between two pillars.
Its arms show a mythical hero said to have founded the region.
